description: EpexPredictor is the repository maintainer's LightGBM model for European day-ahead electricity prices. Its two-stage formulation first predicts each market separately, then uses neighbouring-market forecasts as additional features. Inputs include weather, calendar effects, prices and optional ENTSO-E demand and gas-price information; outputs are price forecasts served through FastAPI or a self-hosted Docker setup. The README lists nine countries and Swedish and Danish bidding zones, with models tuned for 15-minute pricing and a 180-day training window. Source is free under BSD-3-Clause; upstream data services have separate terms. A limitation is that reported backtests use historical weather, so they do not measure the additional error from weather forecasts. Some regions need ENTSO-E API access, and the public service has no availability guarantee. Forecasts can drive storage and charging simulations. evcc (platform-evcc) documents an integration. No forecast service was executed. Related catalogue records are not yet linked.
inputs: Historical electricity prices and optional load/gas data
